fields.mechanism: Decoupling pitch attitude from wing angle of attack to maintain optimal lift-to-drag performance
fields.intervention: Integrate a variable-incidence front spoiler or fixed-wing aerodynamic surface with a dual-actuator drive system that adjusts angle of attack independently of vehicle body pitch
fields.expected_effect: Mitigates aerodynamic drag and maintains optimal lift-to-drag ratio at extreme velocities, improving powertrain energy efficiency
fields.falsification_test: Conduct wind tunnel and on-road testing at target extreme velocities to verify a measurable reduction in drag coefficients and powertrain energy losses without compromising vehicle stability

candidate.intervention: Integrate a variable-incidence front spoiler or fixed-wing aerodynamic surface with a dual-actuator drive system that adjusts angle of attack independently of vehicle body pitch
candidate.expected_effect: Mitigates aerodynamic drag and maintains optimal lift-to-drag ratio at extreme velocities, improving powertrain energy efficiency
candidate.falsification_test: Conduct wind tunnel and on-road testing at target extreme velocities to verify a measurable reduction in drag coefficients and powertrain energy losses without compromising vehicle stability

fields.mechanism: Decoupling aerodynamic surfaces from the main vehicle body via variable incidence to optimize lift-to-drag ratio across varying speeds while maintaining stability.
fields.intervention: Implement variable-incidence rear aerodynamic elements (spoilers or wings) on the high-performance ground vehicle with dual-actuator drive systems to independently adjust angle of attack separate from vehicle pitch/attitude during high-speed travel.
fields.expected_effect: Maximizes passive downforce and minimizes aerodynamic drag at extreme velocities, reducing powertrain energy losses and improving stability without compromising the vehicle's standard suspension geometry.
fields.falsification_test: Conduct high-speed wind tunnel testing to verify that adjusting the rear wing incidence independently of vehicle pitch generates a net increase in downforce with a reduced total drag coefficient, compared to a fixed-angle wing at equivalent vehicle speeds.
fields.mechanism_source_span: effectively decouples fuselage attitude from wing aerodynamics

fields.mechanism: Decoupling fuselage attitude from wing aerodynamics using a variable-incidence lifting surface and dual-actuator drive system.
fields.intervention: Implement an active, variable-incidence rear wing on the ground vehicle that independently adjusts its angle of attack relative to the chassis pitch to maintain optimal lift-to-drag ratios at extreme velocities.
fields.expected_effect: Reduction in aerodynamic drag and powertrain energy losses by maximizing passive downforce efficiency and minimizing flow separation, thereby enabling higher top speeds while maintaining stability.
fields.falsification_test: Conduct wind tunnel testing at target velocities comparing the variable-incidence wing against a fixed-incidence control; failure is confirmed if the active system does not demonstrate a measurable reduction in the coefficient of drag or an improvement in the lift-to-drag ratio under dynamic pitch conditions.
